args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently uses a hardcoded fallback URL of "http://localhost:3000" when process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the email links to point to localhost in production or staging environments where PUBLIC_URL is not configured.

Update the email template code to ensure it uses the correct publicly accessible base URL for the application in the password reset links and other notification emails. This prevents confusion and failed password reset attempts due to invalid URLs.
args.title: Fix password reset email links to use the correct production base URL
